chelsea.line: I remember you well in the Chelsea Hotel
chelsea.lineNext: You were talking so brave and so sweet
stanza: I remember you well in the Chelsea Hotel
You were talking so brave and so sweet
Givin' me head on the unmade bed
While the limousines wait in the street
Those were the reasons, that was New York
We were runnin' for the money and the flesh
And that was called love for the workers in song
Probably still is for those of them left

chelsea.linePrev: And all of that jivin' around
chelsea.line: And I remember you well in the Chelsea Hotel
chelsea.lineNext: You were famous, your heart was a legend
stanza: And I remember you well in the Chelsea Hotel
You were famous, your heart was a legend
You told me again, you preferred handsome men
But for me you would make an exception
And clenching your fist for the ones like us
Who are oppressed by the figures of beauty
You fixed yourself, you said, "Well, never mind
We are ugly but we have the music"

chelsea.linePrev: I’d taken the cure and had just gotten through
